question.text: Which statement is incorrect about peptide bond?

options.text: $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{N}$ bond length in proteins is longer than usual $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{N}$ bond length.

Spectroscopic analysis shows planar structure of
bond.
$\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{N}$ bond length in proteins is smaller than usual $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{N}$ bond length.

solution.text:
Due to resonance,
bond acquires some double bond character, hence shorter in length.
